title: 1 Chronicles 13
paragraphs: ¹ David consulted with his officers over thousands and hundreds — with every leader. ² He said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you, and if this is the will of the LORD our God, let us send word to our brothers who remain in all the territories of Israel, and to the priests and Levites in their towns and pasturelands, and ask them to join us. ³ Then let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we neglected it during the days of Saul." ⁴ The whole assembly agreed to do this, for it seemed right in the eyes of all the people. ⁵ So David assembled all Israel, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.

⁶ David went up with all Israel to Baalah — that is, Kiriath Jearim in Judah — to bring up from there the ark of God, who is enthroned between the cherubim, the ark that bears his name. ⁷ They moved the ark of God from Abinadab's house on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding it. ⁸ David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all their might — with songs, harps, lyres, timbrels, cymbals, and trumpets. ⁹ When they reached the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out his hand to steady the ark, because the oxen stumbled. ¹⁰ The LORD's anger burned against Uzzah, and he struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. He died there before God.

¹¹ David was angry because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; so that place was called Perez Uzzah to this day. ¹² David was afraid of God that day and asked, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?" ¹³ He did not take the ark to the city of David but took it aside to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite. ¹⁴ The ark of God remained with the household of Obed-Edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he had.
